lines: Los Angeles. Seven in the morning. Another day in the Hollywood Hills.
For most people, this is a dream. For Nova Vega, it is Tuesday.
Three number one albums. Two world tours. And one very loud alarm clock.
Act one is complete. The tour begins in Los Angeles.
Okay, world. Let's see what you've got.
Five more minutes. Please.
I'm ready. Where's the car?
Where are the kids?
Seriously? It's not even eight o'clock.
Not today, boys. I have a record to make.
I think I lost them.
Let's make a hit.
Morning, superstar. Coffee's hot, and the whole world is waiting for you.
Ha! Tell that to your manager. He has called six times already.
The garage is open. Take whichever one you like, just don't scratch the paint.
Zoe and Leo are out back, pretending the pool is a pirate ship.
Studio at nine. The label wants to hear the new single. Go make history.
Drive safe. And watch out for the cameras.
Nova! Nova! Over here!
Smile, Nova! Just one picture!
Is it true about the new album?
Nova, where's the family today?
Everyone, quiet! The Queen of the Neon Skyline has arrived.
Take your time, Nova. We're rolling whenever you are.
